rules_summary: Block all inter-VLAN traffic except explicitly permitted
VLAN 25 (Legacy) — NO outbound internet; only inbound RDP from VLAN 10 (IT)
VLAN 30 (IoT) — outbound to NTP/DNS only; inbound blocked except from VLAN 10
VLAN 40 (Billing) — outbound HTTPS to PBM whitelist only; IPSec VPN tunnel to PBM BA
Port 3389 blocked on WAN; GeoIP blocking enabled
IDS/IPS: Suricata with ET Open ruleset
firewall.backup_status: Configuration exported weekly to NAS; no offsite backup

domain_controller.role: Windows Server 2019 — Active Directory, DNS, DHCP
domain_controller.backup_status: Windows Server Backup to NAS nightly; offsite replication to cloud backup monthly (last successful: 2026-05-01)
known_vulnerabilities: Missing KB5036896 (Mar 2026 cumulative update) — remote code execution vector patched in April
SMBv1 not explicitly disabled — legacy pharmacy software dependency (risk acknowledged, migration planned Q3 2026)
